children.text: UCTP
TRN-01 · Register a taxpayer
AC-1 · Section "1 — Create a taxpayer" shows "[full name] created — mobile [mobile]."
Upon page load: Home › Training setup form displays inputs for "Full name", "Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX)", "Email (optional)", and button "Create taxpayer".
Element validations: "Full name" - type text, required.
Functional validations: Successful creation displays exact message format in the result box under the form.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Training setup. 2. Enter valid full name and mobile. 3. Click "Create taxpayer".
A1 · Function + : POST /api/v1/training/taxpayers with {"full_name": "Ana gfdx Dela Cruz", "mobile": "09123456789", "email": ""} -> Status 201 with taxpayer_id
W1 · Inputs + : Fill "Full name" with "Ana gfdx Dela Cruz", "Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX)" with "09123456789", click "Create taxpayer" -> Result box shows "Ana gfdx Dela Cruz created — mobile 09123456789."
I1 · Store + : POST valid taxpayer via API, navigate to My data › My taxpayers -> Record appears in the list with matching details
AC-2 · The same taxpayer details show under My data › My taxpayers.
Upon page load: Top bar link "My data" navigates to My taxpayers page.
Element validations: List container displays created taxpayer records.
Functional validations: Record persisted matches creation payload.
Steps: 1. Create a taxpayer. 2. Click top bar link "My data". 3. Navigate to "My taxpayers".
A2 · Store + : GET /api/v1/training/taxpayers -> Status 200 with list containing created taxpayer object
W2 · Navigation + : Click "My data", view "My taxpayers" -> Details match created taxpayer
I2 · Flow + : Create via form, then verify presence under My data › My taxpayers via UI -> Taxpayer details visible
AC-3 · Spaces around the name are removed, both in the "created" message and in My data.
Upon page load: Form inputs and result displays.
Element validations: "Full name" accepts leading/trailing spaces.
Functional validations: System sanitizes whitespace around the full name.
Steps: 1. Enter full name with surrounding spaces e.g. "   Ana gfdx Dela Cruz   ". 2. Submit.
A3 · Domain/Data + : POST /api/v1/training/taxpayers with {"full_name": "   Ana gfdx Dela Cruz   ", "mobile": "09234567890"} -> Status 201, saved full_name is "Ana gfdx Dela Cruz"
W3 · General + : Type "   Ana gfdx Dela Cruz   " in "Full name", submit -> Result box shows "Ana gfdx Dela Cruz created — mobile 09234567890." without spaces
I3 · Store + : Create with spaced name via UI, check My data › My taxpayers -> Name displays without surrounding spaces
AC-4 · A mobile that's already registered is not accepted. Message: "already registered for this tenant"
Upon page load: Form active.
Element validations: "Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX)" uniqueness check.
Functional validations: Duplicate mobile submission triggers conflict response.
Steps: 1. Create taxpayer with mobile "09345678901". 2. Attempt to create second taxpayer with mobile "09345678901".
A4 · Domain/Data - : POST duplicate mobile -> Status 409 with body {"detail":{"mobile":"already registered for this tenant"}}
W4 · General - : Submit form using an already registered mobile -> Result box shows "already registered for this tenant"
I4 · Flow - : Register mobile via API, attempt registration via UI with same mobile -> Error message displays under mobile field
AC-5 · Name accepts only 2–100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ. Message: "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"
Upon page load: Form active.
Element validations: "Full name" character set and length constraints.
Functional validations: Invalid characters or lengths trigger validation error.
Steps: 1. Enter invalid name. 2. Submit form.
A5 · Syntax - : POST /api/v1/training/taxpayers with {"full_name": "A", "mobile": "09456789012"} -> Status 422 with {"detail":{"full_name":"2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only"}}
W5 · Syntax - : Type "A" in "Full name" and submit -> Message "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only" appears
W6 · Numbers - : Type numeric name "123" and submit -> Message "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only" appears
W7 · General - : Leave "Full name" empty and submit -> Message "2-100 characters: letters, spaces, . - ' and Ñ only" appears
AC-6 · Email is optional. If typed, it needs one @ with a dot after it, 254 characters max. Message: "invalid email format"
Upon page load: "Email (optional)" field empty by default.
Element validations: "Email (optional)" - type email, optional.
Functional validations: Invalid email format triggers validation error.
Steps: 1. Enter invalid email. 2. Submit.
A6 · Syntax - : POST with {"full_name": "Ana gfdx Dela Cruz", "mobile": "09567890123", "email": "invalid-email"} -> Status 422 with {"detail":{"email":"invalid email format"}}
W8 · Syntax - : Type "invalid-email" in "Email (optional)" and submit -> Message "invalid email format" appears
W9 · General - : Leave email empty and submit -> Status 201 successful creation
W10 · Syntax - : Type email missing dot after @ ("test@domain") and submit -> Message "invalid email format" appears
AC-7 · A taxpayer created under my name-tag shows only for that name-tag. Under another name-tag, My data shows "None yet — create one in Training setup." and the Taxpayer lists are empty.
Upon page load: Multi-tenant name-tag isolation.
Element validations: Tenant-scoped data visibility.
Functional validations: Records created under user name-tag are hidden from other name-tags.
Steps: 1. Sign in as "Manuel-8614", create taxpayer. 2. Sign in as "Manuel-8614-other", view My data › My taxpayers.
A7 · User + : GET /api/v1/training/taxpayers with X-User-ID: Manuel-8614-other -> Status 200 with empty list []
W11 · User + : Sign in with "Manuel-8614-other", navigate to My data › My taxpayers -> Displays "None yet — create one in Training setup." and empty list
I5 · User + : Create taxpayer under "Manuel-8614", switch session to "Manuel-8614-other", verify absence in My data -> List is empty
AC-8 · Mobile accepts only 09 + 9 digits, or +639 + 9 digits. No spaces, no dashes. Message: "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"
Upon page load: Form active.
Element validations: "Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX)" format pattern.
Functional validations: Incorrect mobile format or spaces/dashes rejected.
Steps: 1. Enter malformed mobile. 2. Submit.
A8 · Syntax - : POST with mobile "0912345678" (10 digits) -> Status 422 with {"detail":{"mobile":"must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"}}
W12 · Syntax - : Type "09123 456789" (with space) in mobile and submit -> Message "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX" appears
W13 · Syntax - : Type "+63912345678" (10 digits after +63) in mobile and submit -> Message "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX" appears
W14 · Syntax - : Type "08123456789" (invalid prefix) in mobile and submit -> Message "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX" appears
